items.title_zh: 微软 14 年 AI 老将离职：称创新难落地，降本研究未获认真考虑
items.title_en: Microsoft AI Veteran John Langford Leaves After 14 Years, Saying Innovation Struggles to Ship and Cost-Reduction Research Was Not Seriously Considered
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，科技媒体 Windows Latest 今天（11 月 14 日）发布博文， 报道称在微软任职逾 14 年的 AI 科学家、AI Frontiers 实验室联合创始人约翰 · 兰福德（John Langford）已离职。 他表示，离开的关键原因是研究成果看不到实际应用的路径，创新想法甚至难以获得认真考虑。 微软任职逾 14 年的 AI 科学家、AI Frontiers 实验室联合创始人约翰 · 兰福德（John Langford），图源：微软 IT之家查询公开资料，兰福德是机器学习领域资深且有影响力的研究者，长期从事机器学习与学习理论研究，其重要贡献是推进 Contextual Bandits（上下文多臂老虎机），与合作者在探索算法、学习问题归约及离线策略评估方面做出代表性工作，为机器学习系统利用不完整反馈改进决策提供了理论与方法基础。 兰福德所在的约 50 人团队于今年 9 月发生调整，被并入穆斯塔法 · 苏莱曼（Mustafa Suleyman）领导的 Microsoft AI 部门，但在研究路线、创新落地渠道和团队重组方式上存在较大分歧，因此兰福德决定离职。 兰福德承认，扩大模型规模确实能够改善预测效果，而且对企业来说，这条路线的回报更容易预期清晰。但他反对的是把扩大规模当成唯一核心，这会让工作重心过度集中在数据上，挤压探索新方法的空间。 Scott Langford 和 Mustafa Suleyman，图源：微软 兰福德个人倾向于研究创新，而 Microsoft AI 部门更偏重扩大 AI 模型规模，其争议主要涉及兰福德于今年 8 月发布的“全带宽 Transformer”研究。 该研究认为模型生成下一个词元时，不只是利用此前输出的词元，还会重新利用内部的中间状态，减少信息浪费。在论文实验中，10 亿参数模型能够以更少训练数据，接近或达到使用约 1.5 倍数据训练的常规模型表现，每个词元增加的计算开销则很小。 Microsoft AI 模型在 Build 2026 发布会上发布，图源：微软 报道指出，字节跳动 Seed 团队在今年 10 月 25 日发布采用类似思路的 Recycler 研究，该方法以类似方式重用隐藏状态，且在推理和数学方面，能超越参数多两到三倍的模型。
items.summary_en: Tech media outlet Windows Latest reported that John Langford, an AI scientist who spent more than 14 years at Microsoft and co-founded its AI Frontiers lab, has left the company. He said the key reason for leaving was that he saw no path for research results to be applied in practice, and that innovative ideas struggled even to get serious consideration. Langford is a senior and influential machine learning researcher who has long worked on machine learning and learning theory; a major contribution is advancing Contextual Bandits, with representative work done with collaborators on exploration algorithms, reductions for learning problems and off-policy evaluation, providing theoretical and methodological foundations for machine learning systems to improve decisions using incomplete feedback. His roughly 50-person team was reorganized in September this year and folded into the Microsoft AI division led by Mustafa Suleyman, but there were considerable disagreements over research direction, channels for shipping innovation and the way the team was restructured. Langford acknowledged that scaling models does improve prediction and that the returns of this path are easier for companies to forecast, but he opposed treating scaling as the sole core focus, saying it concentrates work excessively on data and squeezes out room to explore new methods. The dispute mainly concerns his "full-bandwidth Transformer" research released in August: it argues that when generating the next token a model should not only use previously output tokens but also reuse internal intermediate states to reduce information waste; in the paper's experiments, a 1-billion-parameter model could approach or match a conventional model trained on about 1.5 times more data with only a small added compute cost per token. The report also noted that ByteDance's Seed team released Recycler research taking a similar approach on October 25 this year, reusing hidden states in a comparable way and surpassing models with two to three times more parameters on reasoning and math.
items.why_zh: 推测：这一离职凸显前沿实验室的探索型研究与企业规模化路线之间的张力，可能影响外界对微软 AI 研究落地能力的判断（仅为推测，缺乏更多证据）。
items.why_en: Speculation: the departure highlights tension between exploratory research in frontier labs and corporate scaling strategies, and could shape outside perceptions of Microsoft's ability to translate AI research into products (speculation only, with limited evidence).

items.title_zh: 谷歌高管借 Gemini AI 成功让苹果 iPhone Duo 运行微软 Win11
items.title_en: Google Executive Says Gemini Helped Him Run Windows 11 on 'iPhone Duo', Open-Sources WindowsiOS Project
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，谷歌 AI Studio 产品与设计负责人阿马尔 · 雷希（Ammaar Reshi）于 11 月 12 日在 X 平台发布推文，分享了一段视频， 演示在苹果首款折叠手机 iPhone Duo 上运行 Windows 11 系统，并在 GitHub 上开源 WindowsiOS 项目。 雷希表示借助谷歌 Gemini 4 Carbon 模型，成功开发 WindowsiOS 项目，通过虚拟机方式，在 iPhone Duo 上运行 Windows 11 on Arm 24H2 系统镜像，并支持触控操作。 根据演示效果，在 iPhone Duo 半折叠状态下，上半屏显示系统界面，下半屏提供虚拟键盘和多点触控板，呈现迷你笔记本的使用形态。项目通过虚拟网卡、音频等设备，让 Windows 调用手机的网络、扬声器和麦克风。 雷希设备无需越狱，方案采用即时编译等软件技术，也不必替换原有 iOS 系统。项目还宣称支持微软 Prism 转译层，可尝试运行部分传统 Windows 应用，但不保证兼容所有软件和游戏。 不过对于普通用户而言，这个开源项目技术门槛偏高，部署需要 Apple 芯片 Mac、开发工具及 Windows ARM 镜像；优化脚本还会关闭 Defender 实时防护和 Windows 更新后台服务等。 IT之家附上参考地址 点此前往 GitHub 访问 WindowsiOS 项目
items.summary_en: Ammaar Reshi, product and design lead at Google AI Studio, posted on X on November 12 a video demonstrating Windows 11 running on Apple's first foldable phone, iPhone Duo, and open-sourced a WindowsiOS project on GitHub. Reshi said he developed the WindowsiOS project with help from Google's Gemini 4 Carbon model, running a Windows 11 on Arm 24H2 image on the iPhone Duo via a virtual machine with touch support. In the demo, with the phone half-folded the top half of the screen shows the system interface while the bottom half provides a virtual keyboard and multi-touch trackpad, resembling a mini laptop; the project uses virtual network and audio devices so Windows can use the phone's network, speaker and microphone. The approach requires no jailbreak, uses software techniques such as just-in-time compilation and does not replace the existing iOS system; the project also claims support for Microsoft's Prism translation layer to attempt running some traditional Windows apps, though compatibility with all software and games is not guaranteed. The barrier is high for ordinary users: deployment requires an Apple Silicon Mac, developer tools and a Windows ARM image, and the optimization scripts also disable Defender real-time protection and Windows Update background services.
items.why_zh: 推测：若演示属实，它展示了本地虚拟化与 AI 辅助开发结合的可能性，但更接近技术演示而非可用产品，实际意义仍需验证（推测）。
items.why_en: Speculation: if the demo holds up, it shows the potential of combining local virtualization with AI-assisted development, but it is closer to a technical demo than a usable product and its practical significance remains to be verified (speculative).

items.title_zh: 礼来 CEO 回应“AI 十年内攻克癌症”：愿景很美好，但不太可能
items.title_en: Eli Lilly CEO responds to 'AI curing cancer within a decade': a desirable vision but unlikely
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，礼来（Eli Lilly）董事长兼首席执行官戴夫 · 里克斯（Dave Ricks）于 11 月 12 日在 X 平台发布推文，回应 Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥 · 阿莫代伊（Dario Amodei）有关“AI 将在不到十年内攻克癌症等疾病”的预测， 称这一愿景“令人向往”，但实现的可能性不大。 IT之家此前报道，在面向投资者的路演视频中，阿莫代伊表示癌症、阿尔茨海默病、心脏病和精神疾病，有望在不到十年内成为“过去式”。 这番对 AI 医疗前景的乐观判断，引发医药界人士质疑 。 里克斯在推文中表示：“如果这个愿景真得令人向往，但是我认为这不太可能发生”。他表示人类对生物学的认识仍有大片空白，而通过随机人体试验获取可靠证据，依然是决定研发进度的关键瓶颈。 里克斯同时表示，自己对 AI 在医药行业的应用感到振奋，但预计进展更可能是“稳步、渐进的”。换言之，更快找到候选药物，并不意味着可以同样迅速地证明它对患者安全、有效；实验室发现距离真正用于治疗，仍有必须完成的验证过程。 礼来（Eli Lilly）董事长兼首席执行官戴夫 · 里克斯（Dave Ricks），图源：礼来 礼来创立于 1876 年，总部位于美国印第安纳波利斯，产品销往约 90 个国家，业务覆盖心血管与代谢疾病、肿瘤、免疫和神经科学等领域。礼来（Eli Lilly）是全球最具影响力的创新药企业之一， 也是糖尿病和肥胖症治疗领域的核心玩家 。它的分量不仅来自规模，更来自把医学发现变成药物、完成临床验证并推向全球市场的长期经验。
items.summary_en: According to an IT之家 report on November 14, Eli Lilly chairman and CEO Dave Ricks posted on X on November 12 responding to Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's prediction that AI will cure cancer and other diseases within less than a decade, calling the vision 'desirable' but unlikely to be realized. Amodei had said in an investor roadshow video that cancer, Alzheimer's disease, heart disease and mental illness could become 'things of the past' in under ten years; that optimistic assessment drew skepticism from people in the pharmaceutical industry. In his post, Ricks said the vision is indeed desirable but he considers it unlikely, noting that there are still large gaps in human understanding of biology and that obtaining reliable evidence through randomized human trials remains the key bottleneck determining R&D timelines. Ricks also said he is excited about AI's use in the pharmaceutical industry but expects progress to be more 'steady and incremental' — finding candidate drugs faster does not mean proving their safety and efficacy in patients as quickly, and there is still a required validation process between a lab discovery and an actual treatment. Eli Lilly was founded in 1876, is headquartered in Indianapolis in the United States, sells products in about 90 countries, covers cardiovascular and metabolic diseases, oncology, immunology and neuroscience, and is one of the core players in diabetes and obesity treatment.
items.why_zh: 这显示 AI 医疗的乐观预期与制药业对临床试验瓶颈的现实判断之间存在分歧（推测），反映了 AI 在药物研发中应用节奏的争议。
items.why_en: This highlights a gap between optimistic AI-in-medicine predictions and the industry's pragmatic view of clinical-trial bottlenecks (speculation), reflecting debate over the pace of AI adoption in drug development.

items.title_zh: Outlook 等服务故障期间征集 AI 技巧，微软推文变成网友吐槽现场
items.title_en: Microsoft Account Asks for AI Tips During Outlook Outage, Tweet Turns Into a Gripe Session
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，科技媒体 Windows Latest 昨日（11 月 13 日）发布博文，报道称在 Outlook 等服务大面积宕机停服的情况下， 微软官方账号 @MicrosoftLearn 不合时宜地询问：“初学者应该尽早养成哪一个 AI 使用习惯？”。 该推文的发布时机恰好是 Outlook 等服务停服的时段，因此迅速成为网友集中表达不满的留言区。IT之家发稿前，该条推文浏览量超过 218.9 万，回复推文数量达到 1,664 条。 其中一条获得逾 4,000 次点赞的回复写道：“确保你的产品不会出故障。”回复还附上微软服务状态页面截图，列出多项服务连接异常的提示。 IT之家发稿前在微软官方推文下方并未找到该推文，且查询 @CEOswithswords 账号也没有该推文，可能是该用户已删除了 故障也让部分用户将矛头指向微软的 AI 投入和人员调整。不过微软此前发布公告，表示本次大规模宕机停服故障和 AI 没有关联，其原因是部分服务器未通过自动健康检查，恢复后又因流量回升而失去响应。微软已暂停部署、回滚近期网络配置变更，并扩大相关补丁的应用范围。
items.summary_en: Tech media outlet Windows Latest reported that during a large-scale outage of Outlook and other services, the official Microsoft account @MicrosoftLearn inopportunely asked: "Which AI habit should beginners build early?" Because the post coincided with the service disruption, it quickly became a place for users to vent. Before publication, the tweet had over 2.189 million views and 1,664 replies. One reply with more than 4,000 likes said, "Make sure your products don't go down," and attached a screenshot of Microsoft's service status page listing multiple services with connectivity problems. Before publication, the tweet could not be found under Microsoft's official post, nor on the @CEOswithswords account, suggesting the user may have deleted it. The outage also led some users to point at Microsoft's AI investments and staffing changes. Microsoft had previously announced that the large-scale outage was not related to AI; the cause was that some servers failed automatic health checks and then became unresponsive as traffic rebounded after recovery, and Microsoft has paused deployments, rolled back recent network configuration changes and broadened the rollout of related patches.
items.why_zh: 推测：事件反映服务可靠性问题会迅速放大公众对企业 AI 宣传的负面情绪，但单一社媒事件不足以说明整体服务质量（推测）。
items.why_en: Speculation: the episode shows how reliability problems can quickly amplify public frustration with corporate AI messaging, though a single social media incident is not enough to characterize overall service quality (speculative).

items.title_zh: 苹果推送 tvOS 27.2.1 更新，第二 / 第三代 Apple TV 4K 新增 Siri AI 支持
items.title_en: Apple releases tvOS 27.2.1, bringing Siri AI to second- and third-generation Apple TV 4K
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，科技媒体 MacRumors 今天（11 月 14 日）发布博文，报道称苹果已推送 tvOS 27.2.1 以及 HomePod Software 27.2.1，内部开发代号均为 24K157。 本次 tvOS 27.2.1 更新最大的亮点， 是苹果面向第二代和第三代 Apple TV 4K 推送 Siri AI 支持 。对这些设备的用户而言，无须更换新款硬件，即可获得此次语音助手升级。 IT之家附上更新日志内容如下： 此次更新为 Apple TV 4K 带来了更强大且更具对话性的 Siri AI。它还增加了最多四个 HomePod 扬声器连接到 Apple TV 4K（第四代）的功能，并提供了漏洞修复和安全更新。 Siri AI 一个更强大、更能对话的 Siri 版本，帮助你找到所需内容并完成更多事情。 改进的搜索功能帮助你在 Apple TV 应用中发现完美的电影或电视剧，带来全新丰富、全屏的体验。 个人情境理解借助你支持苹果智能的 iPhone，帮你找到想要的东西。 广博的世界知识让你几乎可以就任何话题提问，并获得详细的答案。 屏幕上的意识功能会回答你在 Apple TV 上看什么的疑问，所以在你最喜欢的剧集播放时，你可以问下一季什么时候播出。 Apple TV 4K 上的 Siri AI 提供英文版本，需要支持苹果智能功能的 iPhone 或 iPad 来设置。 Home 家庭影院 家庭影院环绕声支持连接四个 HomePod 扬声器，带来沉浸式、多维度的聆听体验。 Whole Room Audio 将声音均匀分布到四个扬声器，非常适合派对或比赛日。 需要 Apple TV 4K（第四代）以及前后配对的 HomePod mini 2 或 HomePod（第二代）。 消息源相比之下，HomePod 27.2.1 的更新内容较为有限。苹果发布说明仅表示，本次更新提供错误修复，并未加入 Siri AI。
items.summary_en: According to a MacRumors report on November 14, Apple has released tvOS 27.2.1 and HomePod Software 27.2.1, both with internal build code 24K157. The biggest highlight of the tvOS update is Siri AI support for the second- and third-generation Apple TV 4K, so users of those devices can get the voice assistant upgrade without buying new hardware. The release notes say the update brings a more capable, more conversational Siri AI to Apple TV 4K, adds support for connecting up to four HomePod speakers to Apple TV 4K (4th generation), and includes bug fixes and security updates. Siri AI capabilities described include improved search that helps users find movies and shows in the Apple TV app with a new rich, full-screen experience; personal context understanding via a user's Apple Intelligence-capable iPhone; broad world knowledge for answering questions on almost any topic; and on-screen awareness that can answer questions about what is being watched, such as when the next season of a show will air. Siri AI on Apple TV 4K is available in English and requires an Apple Intelligence-capable iPhone or iPad for setup. For home theater, surround sound supports connecting four HomePod speakers, and Whole Room Audio distributes sound evenly across the four speakers; this requires Apple TV 4K (4th generation) plus paired HomePod mini 2 or HomePod (2nd generation) units. By comparison, the HomePod 27.2.1 release notes mention only bug fixes and no Siri AI.
items.why_zh: 若属实，这意味着旧款 Apple TV 4K 可通过软件更新获得对话式语音助手，可能延长现有硬件生命周期（推测）。
items.why_en: If accurate, this means older Apple TV 4K units gain a conversational voice assistant via software update, potentially extending the useful life of existing hardware (speculation).

items.title_zh: 实现“躺平式办公”：Mac 版 Perplexity 上线“AI 队友”，组建你的全天候数字员工
items.title_en: Perplexity brings its 'Teammates' AI agents to its Mac app
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，Perplexity 今天（11 月 14 日）发布公告，邀请付费 Max 订阅用户，在 Mac 平台版 Perplexity 应用上体验 AI 智能体功能“队友”（Teammates）。 该功能此前仅支持 iOS 和网页端，如今进一步覆盖桌面办公场景。 Teammates 可以理解为一组各有分工的“AI 队友”。与需要用户反复提问、逐步下达指令的聊天方式不同，它主打围绕一项职责持续推进工作。用户交代任务后，AI 会规划执行步骤，并跟进至结果可供用户审阅。IT之家附上相关介绍视频如下： 根据 Perplexity 的介绍，用户可以让这些“队友”管理增长营销活动、分类处理新收到的软件错误报告、跟踪业务指标，或开展新市场研究。 任务规模扩大时，系统还可引入更多 AI 智能体协作。官方列举的应用场景包括质量保证、客户服务、研究和增长营销，既支持单个智能体工作，也支持多个“队友”配合。 此次更新建立在 Perplexity 现有的 AI 编排系统之上，重点是让 AI 从“回答问题”进一步转向“持续负责一项工作”。不过，上述能力属于官方功能介绍，报道未提供独立实测结果，也未披露具体使用额度、Mac 系统版本要求等细节。 相关阅读： 《 Perplexity 推出 Teammate 功能：可执行持续性复杂工作的智能体 》
items.summary_en: According to an IT之家 report on November 14, Perplexity announced the same day that it is inviting paying Max subscribers to try its 'Teammates' AI agent feature in the Mac version of the Perplexity app. The feature was previously available only on iOS and the web and now extends to desktop work scenarios. Teammates can be understood as a set of 'AI teammates' each with a division of labor; unlike chat interactions where users must repeatedly ask questions and issue step-by-step instructions, it focuses on continuously advancing work around a responsibility: after a user assigns a task, the AI plans execution steps and follows through until results are ready for review. Per Perplexity, users can have these 'teammates' manage growth marketing campaigns, triage newly received software bug reports, track business metrics, or conduct new market research; as task scale grows, the system can bring in more AI agents to collaborate. Official use cases listed include quality assurance, customer service, research and growth marketing, supporting both single-agent work and coordination among multiple 'teammates.' The update builds on Perplexity's existing AI orchestration system, with the emphasis on moving AI from 'answering questions' toward 'continuously owning a piece of work.' The report notes that these capabilities come from the company's feature description, with no independent hands-on testing results provided and no details disclosed on usage limits or required Mac OS versions.
items.why_zh: 若功能如描述般运作，AI 产品可能从问答工具转向承担持续性工作流，影响办公软件与智能体市场竞争格局（推测）。
items.why_en: If the feature works as described, AI products could shift from Q&A tools to owners of ongoing workflows, affecting competition in productivity software and agent platforms (speculation).

items.title_zh: DeepSeek 前端代码出现“额度耗尽”提示，开发者猜测将首次推出 C 端付费方案
items.title_en: DeepSeek front-end code shows 'quota exhausted' prompts; developers speculate on first consumer paid plan
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息， 有开发者在 chat.deepseek.com 的前端代码中发现了一整套额度管理逻辑，提示文案包括“使用额度已达上限，请额度恢复后再试”。 此外，其代码还包含额度耗尽后的错误处理分支，以及“分享对话后继续聊”场景下对 quotas 数组中 is_exhausted 状态的检查 。 根据开发者们挖出的信息，最新前端 commit 已经支持「额度状态轮询」：页面可见时每 5 分钟同步各模型额度、禁言状态与服务端文案。当 额度耗尽时，DeepSeek 输入框上方会直接出提示条，首页欢迎区也改为服务端下发的额度说明。 这套前端体系涵盖剩余额度实时同步、额度耗尽即时提醒、额度恢复通知以及服务端用量限额预警，指向一个名为“Coding Plan”的专属套餐 。有网友认为，深度求索将会在 DeepSeek V4.1 Pro 上线的同时推出其首个 C 端付费方案。 不过，截至IT之家发稿时，DeepSeek 官方尚未公布任何订阅方案的价格、层级或上线日期，相关消息均为社区用户推测 。 在此之前，DeepSeek 唯一直接向个人收费的入口是开放平台的 API，按 Token 用量计费，与“开会员多聊天”是两套逻辑 。 2026 年 10 月，DeepSeek 将 Harness 团队与 Web、App、Platform 三个团队整合为产品部，由原 Harness 负责人崔添翼统筹全部产品、设计和研发工作 。同期数据显示，DeepSeek 月活跃用户约 1.30 亿，年化营收突破 10 亿美元几乎全部来自 API，C 端仍未向用户直接收费，且月活在前三中唯一出现同比缩水 。 相关阅读： 《 DeepSeek 发布全家桶应用 API：开发者将能 1:1 复刻完整 DeepSeek App 》 《 DeepSeek 网页 / API 服务恢复正常，今天下午一度中断 45 分钟 》 《 （更新：已恢复）DeepSeek 网页 / API 服务突发部分中断，提示“服务器暂时不可用” 》 《 DeepSeek Harness：日活跃用户达 154 万、日消耗 Token 约 92 万亿，将建设官方插件市场 》 《 DeepSeek 网页 / API 服务出现部分中断，官方正在排查 》
items.summary_en: According to an IT之家 report on November 14, developers found a complete quota-management logic in the front-end code of chat.deepseek.com, with prompt text including 'usage quota has reached its limit, please try again after your quota is restored.' The code also contains error-handling branches for exhausted quotas and checks of the is_exhausted state in a quotas array in the 'continue chatting after sharing a conversation' scenario. Based on what developers uncovered, the latest front-end commit already supports 'quota status polling': while the page is visible, it syncs each model's quota, mute status and server-side copy every five minutes; when the quota is exhausted, a notice bar appears above the DeepSeek input box, and the home-page welcome area is changed to a server-delivered quota explanation. This front-end system covers real-time syncing of remaining quota, instant alerts on exhaustion, quota-restoration notifications and server-side usage-limit warnings, pointing to an exclusive package called 'Coding Plan.' Some online users believe DeepSeek will launch its first consumer paid plan alongside the release of DeepSeek V4.1 Pro. However, as of IT之家's publication, DeepSeek has not officially announced any subscription plan's price, tier or launch date, and the related claims are community speculation. Previously, DeepSeek's only channel for directly charging individuals was the open-platform API, billed by Token usage, which follows a different logic from 'buying a membership for more chatting.' In October 2026, DeepSeek merged its Harness team with the Web, App and Platform teams into a product department, with former Harness head Cui Tianyi overseeing all product, design and R&D work. Data from the same period showed DeepSeek had about 130 million monthly active users, annualized revenue exceeding US$1 billion almost entirely from the API, no direct consumer charges, and it was the only one of the top three to see a year-on-year decline in monthly active users.
items.why_zh: 若付费方案落地，将标志 DeepSeek 从纯 API 变现转向消费者订阅，但当前仅为社区推测，尚需官方确认（推测）。

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息， 有开发者在 chat.deepseek.com 的前端代码中发现了一整套额度管理逻辑，提示文案包括“使用额度已达上限，请额度恢复后再试”。 此外，其代码还包含额度耗尽后的错误处理分支，以及“分享对话后继续聊”场景下对 quotas 数组中 is_exhausted 状态的检查 。 根据开发者们挖出的信息，最新前端 commit 已经支持「额度状态轮询」：页面可见时每 5 分钟同步各模型额度、禁言状态与服务端文案。当 额度耗尽时，DeepSeek 输入框上方会直接出提示条，首页欢迎区也改为服务端下发的额度说明。 这套前端体系涵盖剩余额度实时同步、额度耗尽即时提醒、额度恢复通知以及服务端用量限额预警，指向一个名为“Coding Plan”的专属套餐 。有网友认为，深度求索将会在 DeepSeek V4.1 Pro 上线的同时推出其首个 C 端付费方案。 不过，截至IT之家发稿时，DeepSeek 官方尚未公布任何订阅方案的价格、层级或上线日期，相关消息均为社区用户推测 。 在此之前，DeepSeek 唯一直接向个人收费的入口是开放平台的 API，按 Token 用量计费，与“开会员多聊天”是两套逻辑 。 2026 年 10 月，DeepSeek 将 Harness 团队与 Web、App、Platform 三个团队整合为产品部，由原 Harness 负责人崔添翼统筹全部产品、设计和研发工作 。同期数据显示，DeepSeek 月活跃用户约 1.30 亿，年化营收突破 10 亿美元几乎全部来自 API，C 端仍未向用户直接收费，且月活在前三中唯一出现同比缩水 。 相关阅读： 《 DeepSeek 发布全家桶应用 API：开发者将能 1:1 复刻完整 DeepSeek App 》 《 DeepSeek 网页 / API 服务恢复正常，今天下午一度中断 45 分钟 》 《 （更新：已恢复）DeepSeek 网页 / API 服务突发部分中断，提示“服务器暂时不可用” 》 《 DeepSeek Harness：日活跃用户达 154 万、日消耗 Token 约 92 万亿，将建设官方插件市场 》 《 DeepSeek 网页 / API 服务出现部分中断，官方正在排查 》

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，开发者 Georgi Gerganov（X 账号为 @ggerganov）昨日（11 月 13 日）在 X 平台发布推文， 宣布开源 AI 推理项目 llama.cpp 与底层机器学习引擎 ggml 的库版本迈入 1.0.0。 IT之家查询公开资料，Gerganov 是开源项目 llama.cpp 的创建者，也是 ggml、 whisper.cpp 等本地 AI 基础软件的重要开发者。他在个人 X 简介中将自己标注为 Hugging Face 工程师，GitHub 资料所在地为保加利亚索非亚。 llama.cpp 是一个主要用 C/C++ 编写的开源 AI 推理项目，核心作用是让大语言模型在个人电脑、服务器等不同硬件上运行。它既可以用于本地部署，也可以用于云端服务，目标是降低部署复杂度，并充分利用设备的计算能力。 本次更新最大的亮点就是明确接口兼容性规则： 项目 库 定位 llama.cpp libllama C/C++ 大模型推理库 ggml libggml 底层机器学习张量库 两者今后都会通过主版本号升级，明确标记 API 或 ABI 不兼容的变化，让依赖这些库的应用能够识别升级边界。对于开发者而言，可以从版本号上，更容易判断某次升级是否可能要求自己的应用同步修改。官方给出的版本规则是： 版本位 什么情况下更新 MAJOR，例如 1.x.x → 2.0.0 ./include 中公共 C API 出现破坏性变更；公告同时明确，API / ABI 不兼容会通过主版本升级体现 MINOR，例如 1.0.x → 1.1.0 向后兼容的功能、后端更新、模型支持或 API 新增 PATCH，例如 1.0.0 → 1.0.1 不改变 API 的 bug 修复 在工程质量方面，官方公告称为了支撑持续加快的开发节奏，团队强调了三项投入： 使用 Hugging Face 的 HF Buckets、HF Jobs 扩展 CI 基础设施。 在 NVIDIA、AMD、Qualcomm、Arm、IBM、Intel 的硬件支持下，持续增加覆盖主要硬件平台的自托管测试运行器。 在开发流程中审慎使用 LLM，同时继续把代码质量、架构控制和对实现细节的理解放在首位。 在后端与模型支持方面，ggml 通过专用后端支持不同硬件；每个后端都可以编译为动态库，并按需在运行时加载。 llama.cpp 已支持超过 150 种模型架构变体及主流推测解码方法。团队还将继续加强自动化测试基础设施，并借助英伟达、AMD、高通、Arm、IBM 和英特尔提供的硬件支持，扩大跨平台测试覆盖。
items.summary_en: According to an IT之家 report on November 14, developer Georgi Gerganov (X account @ggerganov) posted on X on November 13 announcing that the library versions of the open-source AI inference project llama.cpp and the underlying machine learning engine ggml have reached 1.0.0. Gerganov is the creator of llama.cpp and an important developer of local AI infrastructure such as ggml and whisper.cpp; his X bio lists him as a Hugging Face engineer. llama.cpp is an open-source AI inference project written mainly in C/C++, whose core purpose is to run large language models on various hardware including personal computers and servers; it can be used for both local deployment and cloud services, aiming to reduce deployment complexity and make full use of device compute. The biggest highlight of this release is explicit interface compatibility rules: llama.cpp corresponds to libllama (a C/C++ LLM inference library) and ggml to libggml (the underlying machine learning tensor library), and both will from now on mark API or ABI incompatibilities through major version bumps so that dependent applications can recognize upgrade boundaries. The official version rules are: MAJOR (e.g., 1.x.x → 2.0.0) is updated when there are breaking changes to the public C API in ./include, with API/ABI incompatibilities reflected in major version upgrades; MINOR (e.g., 1.0.x → 1.1.0) covers backward-compatible features, backend updates, model support or API additions; PATCH (e.g., 1.0.0 → 1.0.1) covers bug fixes that do not change the API. On engineering quality, the team highlighted three investments: scaling CI infrastructure with Hugging Face's HF Buckets and HF Jobs; continuing to add self-hosted test runners covering major hardware platforms with hardware support from NVIDIA, AMD, Qualcomm, Arm, IBM and Intel; and using LLMs prudently in the development process while continuing to prioritize code quality, architectural control and understanding of implementation details. On backends and model support, ggml supports different hardware through dedicated backends, each of which can be compiled as a dynamic library and loaded at runtime as needed; llama.cpp already supports more than 150 model architecture variants and mainstream speculative decoding methods. The team will continue strengthening automated testing infrastructure and expanding cross-platform test coverage with hardware support from the aforementioned vendors. The report's headline phrase about running large models fully offline summarizes its local inference capability.
items.why_zh: 1.0.0 版本与明确的语义化版本规则可能降低下游项目升级风险，影响本地推理生态的稳定性（推测）。
items.why_en: The 1.0.0 release and explicit semantic versioning rules may reduce upgrade risk for downstream projects and affect the stability of the local inference ecosystem (speculation).

items.title_en: OpenAI Reorganizes Embodied AI Team to Make General Models Such as GPT-6 Astra Robot 'Brains'
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，《财富》昨日（11 月 13 日）发布博文，爆料称 OpenAI 已解散独立机器人团队，并将相关人员调至公司其他部门。OpenAI 向该媒体确认了此次组织调整， 只是强调本次调整并非退出机器人领域，机器人仍是其长期愿景的核心，重组旨在加快研发。 在架构调整方面，机器人研究人员并入核心研究团队，向首席研究官马克 · 陈（Mark Chen）汇报；应用机器人与硬件团队则转入规模更大的应用部门，该部门由公司总裁格雷格 · 布罗克曼（Greg Brockman）负责。IT之家附上相关截图如下;d 对于本次架构调整的根源，OpenAI 官方回应称包括 GPT-6 Astra 在内，通用模型已能直接用于部分机器人任务，因此决定将相关研究进一步整合到通用模型研发中。 OpenAI 希望让能理解文字、图像和代码的 AI，也成为机器人的“大脑”，而不再完全依赖专门为机器人开发的模型。报道援引英伟达一项研究称，Astra 驱动的智能体在一项模拟操作测试中取得 74.8% 的成功率，高于该榜单领先专用模型的 51.0%。 通用模型能否全面接手机器人，仍有现实难题。受访学者指出，大模型运行速度和云端联网需求构成限制，机器人企业积累的现场经验与数据也仍有价值。据报道，OpenAI 正研发自有人形机器人，目标于 2027 年首次公开演示。
items.summary_en: IT之家, Nov 14: Fortune published a post on Nov 13 reporting that OpenAI has disbanded its standalone robotics team and moved the staff to other departments. OpenAI confirmed the organizational change to the outlet but stressed it is not exiting robotics, saying robotics remains core to its long-term vision and the reorganization is meant to speed up R&D. Under the new structure, robotics researchers join the core research team reporting to Chief Research Officer Mark Chen, while the applied robotics and hardware team moves into the larger applied department led by President Greg Brockman. On the reason for the change, OpenAI said general models including GPT-6 Astra can already be used directly for some robotics tasks, so it decided to further integrate the related research into general-model development. OpenAI wants AI that understands text, images and code to also serve as robots' "brain" rather than relying entirely on models built specifically for robots. The report cited an Nvidia study saying an Astra-driven agent achieved a 74.8% success rate in a simulated manipulation test, above the 51.0% of the leading specialized model on that leaderboard. Whether general models can fully take over robotics still faces practical difficulties: scholars interviewed cited limits from model operating speed and the need for cloud connectivity, and said robotics companies' field experience and data still have value. OpenAI is reportedly developing its own humanoid robot, targeting a first public demonstration in 2027.
items.why_zh: 推测：若通用模型能承担机器人控制，将改变具身智能的研发路径与软件栈，但目前依据仅为厂商表态和单项模拟测试结果，尚需独立验证。
items.why_en: Speculation: if general models can handle robot control, that would reshape embodied-AI R&D and software stacks, but the current basis is only vendor statements and one simulated test result, and independent verification is still needed.

items.title_zh: 让智能体帮你购物，OpenAI 推出支付功能 ChatGPT Wallet
items.title_en: OpenAI launches payment feature ChatGPT Wallet, letting agents shop for users
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，OpenAI 今天（13 日）宣布推出支付功能 ChatGPT Wallet，让旗下 dot AI 智能体代替用户购物。 ChatGPT Wallet 由 OpenAI 与美国运通、万事达卡和 Visa 合作开发，用户使用现有信用卡付款时，仍可享受原有的积分奖励和权益保障。符合条件的用户只需录入一次银行卡信息， 随后便可让 dot 智能体帮忙寻找商品，每笔交易都需要通过安全验证才能完成 。 OpenAI 强调，dot 智能体 不会接触用户的真实银行卡信息 。支付网络会为每笔交易生成专用的支付令牌，其中包含 限定用途的卡号、安全码和有效期 ，供智能体完成付款。 当今，越来越多消费者开始尝试用个人 AI 智能体管理日程、预订旅行和处理其他日常事务，ChatGPT Wallet 在这样的背景下应运而生。 ChatGPT Wallet 未来有望成为 OpenAI 新的收入来源。初期不会向交易收取佣金，OpenAI 当前的目标是更希望与商家建立合作关系，让消费者逐渐 将 ChatGPT 视为购物平台 ，尤其是在商家也开始探索个人 AI 智能体的用途之际。 ChatGPT Wallet 初期仅向美国年满 18 岁的 OpenAI Pro 订阅用户开放。 据IT之家了解，截至今年第三季度末，ChatGPT 每周活跃用户超过 12 亿，付费用户接近 1 亿 。 OpenAI 指出，利用 AI 智能体购物仍处于起步阶段。公司在发布 ChatGPT Wallet 的同时，还推出了面向企业的工具和指南，帮助商家适应这种变化，其中就包括 如何检查网站是否误拦截了 OpenAI 的智能体 。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 13 that OpenAI announced the launch of the payment feature ChatGPT Wallet today (the 13th), letting its dot AI agent shop on users’ behalf. ChatGPT Wallet was developed by OpenAI with American Express, Mastercard, and Visa; when users pay with existing credit cards, they can still enjoy their original rewards and protections. Eligible users need to enter their bank card information once, after which they can ask the dot agent to help find products, and every transaction must pass security verification. OpenAI emphasized that the dot agent will not touch users’ real bank card information. The payment network generates a dedicated payment token for each transaction, including a limited-use card number, security code, and expiration date, for the agent to complete payment. As more consumers try personal AI agents to manage schedules, book travel, and handle other daily tasks, ChatGPT Wallet arrives in this context. ChatGPT Wallet is expected to become a new revenue source for OpenAI in the future. Initially, no commission will be charged on transactions; OpenAI’s current goal is to build merchant partnerships and gradually make consumers view ChatGPT as a shopping platform, especially as merchants also begin exploring uses for personal AI agents. ChatGPT Wallet is initially available only to OpenAI Pro subscribers aged 18 and over in the United States. According to IT之家, by the end of the third quarter this year, ChatGPT had more than 1.2 billion weekly active users and nearly 100 million paid users. OpenAI noted that shopping with AI agents is still in its early stages. Along with ChatGPT Wallet, the company also launched enterprise-facing tools and guides to help merchants adapt to this change, including how to check whether a website mistakenly blocks OpenAI’s agents.
items.why_zh: 推测：若支付令牌与验证机制按描述落地，这可能推动 AI 智能体从信息助手走向实际交易入口，并影响电商流量与支付合作格局。

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，OpenAI 今天（13 日）宣布推出支付功能 ChatGPT Wallet，让旗下 dot AI 智能体代替用户购物。 ChatGPT Wallet 由 OpenAI 与美国运通、万事达卡和 Visa 合作开发，用户使用现有信用卡付款时，仍可享受原有的积分奖励和权益保障。符合条件的用户只需录入一次银行卡信息， 随后便可让 dot 智能体帮忙寻找商品，每笔交易都需要通过安全验证才能完成 。 OpenAI 强调，dot 智能体 不会接触用户的真实银行卡信息 。支付网络会为每笔交易生成专用的支付令牌，其中包含 限定用途的卡号、安全码和有效期 ，供智能体完成付款。 当今，越来越多消费者开始尝试用个人 AI 智能体管理日程、预订旅行和处理其他日常事务，ChatGPT Wallet 在这样的背景下应运而生。 ChatGPT Wallet 未来有望成为 OpenAI 新的收入来源。初期不会向交易收取佣金，OpenAI 当前的目标是更希望与商家建立合作关系，让消费者逐渐 将 ChatGPT 视为购物平台 ，尤其是在商家也开始探索个人 AI 智能体的用途之际。 ChatGPT Wallet 初期仅向美国年满 18 岁的 OpenAI Pro 订阅用户开放。 据IT之家了解，截至今年第三季度末，ChatGPT 每周活跃用户超过 12 亿，付费用户接近 1 亿 。 OpenAI 指出，利用 AI 智能体购物仍处于起步阶段。公司在发布 ChatGPT Wallet 的同时，还推出了面向企业的工具和指南，帮助商家适应这种变化，其中就包括 如何检查网站是否误拦截了 OpenAI 的智能体 。

items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 13 that, according to Fortune on the 12th local time, AI startup Anthropic is about to see one of the most closely watched IPOs in history. However, on the eve of listing, Nvidia co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang suddenly resigned. By the time Anthropic formally enters the capital market, only a week will have passed since the AI industry lost one of its most influential figures and one of the best at selling the industry’s prospects. Huang’s sudden departure adds new pressure to Anthropic’s listing plan. The IPO was already seen as an important test of investors’ enthusiasm for AI investment. Anthropic is expected to list on November 18 or 19, just as Nvidia reports its first quarterly earnings after Huang stepped down as CEO. Nvidia is not only an important partner of Anthropic but also deeply involved in the IPO. Anthropic’s filings show that Nvidia agreed to subscribe to about $10 billion of shares in a $26 billion private placement concurrent with the IPO. The two companies also have close business ties: Anthropic has committed tens of billions of dollars to ensure access to Nvidia’s most advanced chips. Several investors and analysts noted that while Nvidia’s personnel change is not expected to affect Anthropic’s core business, it could shake market confidence in the entire AI industry. Seaport Research Partners analyst Jay Goldberg is one of the few on Wall Street with a sell rating on Nvidia. He believes Huang’s departure will not affect Anthropic’s listing: 'They are listing right when Nvidia reports earnings; I don’t think this will disrupt the listing plan. This IPO is simply too large, and too many people are involved; they will not withdraw.' Goldberg is more worried about Anthropic’s situation after listing. Before Huang formally resigned, there had already been reports that he might leave. Goldberg warned at the time that turmoil at Nvidia, especially losing its CEO, would put pressure on Anthropic’s first quarterly report after listing. 'At the very least, the market will begin to ask: Can the AI boom continue? Can it keep developing this way? Anthropic will face sharper questioning.' Karl Alomar, a partner at venture capital firm M13, likewise believes Anthropic’s fundamentals have not changed: 'In my view, Anthropic’s situation is as good and as strong as it was before the news came out. Anthropic’s financial data is excellent, and it clearly has compute reserves beyond its own needs. They have not spent that much.' Compared with some competitors, Anthropic is also less dependent on Nvidia. In addition to Nvidia hardware, Anthropic uses Google TPUs, Amazon Trainium chips, and AMD GPUs to run some AI models. According to reports, Anthropic is also considering developing its own chips. Accountant and investigative journalist Francine McKenna, who formerly taught at Wharton, believes Nvidia’s investment commitment to Anthropic is likely unaffected: 'Nvidia promised to invest $10 billion when Anthropic lists. When the IPO actually starts, that investment will likely still happen. But if anyone expects Nvidia to rescue CoreWeave if necessary, they had better look elsewhere.' However, Jason Schloetzer, an associate professor at Georgetown University’s McDonough School of Business, believes Nvidia’s recent turmoil and doubts about Huang’s judgment could also lead partners to face stricter scrutiny. He expects the market to examine more carefully the ties between Anthropic and Nvidia and Nvidia’s customers. In Silicon Valley, Anthropic and rival OpenAI have enormous fundraising needs, and almost all venture capital firms hold shares in both companies, making their position in the private market resemble index funds. Therefore, Anthropic’s IPO expected next week will be a major liquidity event, affecting not only the interests of more than 400 investors but also the prospects of the entire AI boom. The market widely believes that if Anthropic lists successfully, the AI boom still has considerable room to grow; if the listing fails or is delayed indefinitely, it would clearly send a negative signal that the AI bubble is close to bursting. However, Huang’s departure may not necessarily hurt Anthropic’s listing. At least one venture investor believes Anthropic may actually benefit. The two sides also differ on AI regulation; Huang especially opposes licensing requirements that could make it harder for customers to use open-source AI models. items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，在今年 9 月 7 日的 HarmonyOS 7 | HUAWEI Mate XT 2 及全场景新品发布会上，鸿蒙 7 操作系统正式发布。在发布会现场， 华为还剧透了全新功能 —— 小艺 AI 快捷栏 。官方 PPT 页面显示，该功能开启后，小艺将在手机桌面底部的 Dock 栏常驻。 今年 10 月，华为客户服务曾透露该功能预计在 10 月底或 11 月初逐步和大家见面。IT之家今日再次就该功能的上线时间进行了询问，对方给出了更详细的计划表： 推送时间 手机型号 平板型号 2026 年 11 月中旬 HUAWEI Mate 90 ，Mate 90 Pro，Mate 90 RS，Pura X View / 2026 年 12 月（第一批推送） ·Mate 80 系列 ·Pura 90 Pro、Pura 90 Pro Max、Pura 90 ·Pura X Max 系列 ·Mate X7 系列 ·nova 16 Ultra、nova 16 Pro、nova 16、nova 16z MatePad Mini、MatePad 11.5 2026、MatePad Edge、MatePad Pro Max、HUAWEI MatePad Pro 12 英寸 2026、HUAWEI MatePad Air 12 英寸（第三代）、 HUAWEI MatePad Air Z 2026 年 12 月（第二批推送） ·Mate 70、Mate 70 Pro、Mate 70 Pro 优享版、Mate 70 Pro+、Mate 70 RS、Mate 70 Air ·Mate X6 系列 ·Pura 80 系列 ·Pura X 系列 ·Pura 70、Pura 70 Pro、Pura 70 Pro+、Pura 70 Ultra、Pura 70 北斗卫星消息版 ·Mate 60、Mate 60 Pro、Mate 60 Pro+、Mate 60 RS | ULTIMATE DESIGN ·nova 15 系列和 nova 14 系列 MatePad Pro 13.2 2025、MatePad Pro 12.2 2025、MatePad Air 12 2025、MatePad 11.5 S 2025 2027 年 1 月初 ·Mate XTs、Mate XT 非凡大师 ·Mate X5 系列 ·Pocket 2 系列 ·nova Flip 系列 ·nova 13 系列 ·nova 12、nova 12 Ultra、nova 12 Ultra 星耀版、nova 12 Pro MatePad Pro 13.2 2023、MatePad Pro 11 2024、MatePad Pro 12.2 2024、MatePad Air 12 2024、MatePad 11.5"S 2024 华为客户服务表示，12GB 及以上内存的手机、折叠屏、平板机型支持 AI 快捷栏， 其他机型推送计划会持续刷新 。 相关阅读： 《 华为鸿蒙 HarmonyOS 7 操作系统正式发布：全新空间美学设计语言，搭载系统智能体小艺 》

At the event, Huawei also teased a new feature: the Xiaoyi AI Quick Bar. The official PPT page showed that once enabled, Xiaoyi will stay in the Dock at the bottom of the phone desktop. In October this year, Huawei customer service said the feature was expected to roll out gradually in late October or early November. IT之家 asked again today about the rollout time, and customer service provided a more detailed schedule: mid-November 2026, HUAWEI Mate 90, Mate 90 Pro, Mate 90 RS, and Pura X View; December 2026 (first batch), phones include the Mate 80 series, Pura 90 Pro, Pura 90 Pro Max, Pura 90, Pura X Max series, Mate X7 series, nova 16 Ultra, nova 16 Pro, nova 16, and nova 16z, while tablets include MatePad Mini, MatePad 11.5 2026, MatePad Edge, MatePad Pro Max, HUAWEI MatePad Pro 12-inch 2026, HUAWEI MatePad Air 12-inch (third generation), and HUAWEI MatePad Air Z; December 2026 (second batch), phones include Mate 70, Mate 70 Pro, Mate 70 Pro 优享版, Mate 70 Pro+, Mate 70 RS, Mate 70 Air, Mate X6 series, Pura 80 series, Pura X series, Pura 70, Pura 70 Pro, Pura 70 Pro+, Pura 70 Ultra, Pura 70 北斗卫星消息版, Mate 60, Mate 60 Pro, Mate 60 Pro+, Mate 60 RS | ULTIMATE DESIGN, nova 15 series, and nova 14 series, while tablets include MatePad Pro 13.2 2025, MatePad Pro 12.2 2025, MatePad Air 12 2025, and MatePad 11.5 S 2025; early January 2027, phones include Mate XTs, Mate XT 非凡大师, Mate X5 series, Pocket 2 series, nova Flip series, nova 13 series, nova 12, nova 12 Ultra, nova 12 Ultra 星耀版, and nova 12 Pro, while tablets include MatePad Pro 13.2 2023, MatePad Pro 11 2024, MatePad Pro 12.2 2024, MatePad Air 12 2024, and MatePad 11.5"S 2024. Huawei customer service said that phones, foldables, and tablets with 12GB or more RAM support the AI Quick Bar, and rollout plans for other models will continue to be updated. Related reading: 'Huawei HarmonyOS 7 officially released: a new spatial aesthetic design language, featuring the system agent Xiaoyi.'

items.title_zh: DeepSeek 发布全家桶应用 API：开发者将能 1:1 复刻完整 DeepSeek App
items.title_en: DeepSeek releases full-suite app API, enabling developers to replicate the complete DeepSeek App 1:1
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，今天（13 日）晚间，DeepSeek 宣布正式开放全家桶应用 API：在原有 API 中开启对应参数， 即可获得深度思考搜索、文件输入等对话功能 ；语音及相关底层能力也已开放独立接口（含 OCR、ASR、TTS 等），支持单独或组合调用。 开发者可以在自己的应用中轻松实现复杂的对话功能， 甚至 1:1 复刻出完整的 DeepSeek App 。 本次更新将 DeepSeek App 的各项交互功能直接整合进原有 API。开启对应参数后，相关工具调用与上下文拼接均由服务端自动完成。 目前，V4.1-Flash 模型（deepseek-flash）已在 Messages、Responses 与 Chat Completions 接口下支持以下能力： 联网搜索： 在非思考模式下，打开 deepseek_web_search 工具后，模型可根据提问自动发起网页或图片搜索并附引用作答； 深度思考搜索： 在思考模式下，打开 deepseek_web_search 工具后，模型可在多步推理中自主联网搜索与阅读链接； 文件输入： 支持上传 PDF、Office、图片等格式的文件，完成纯文本提取或图文混排解析后，拼入对话上下文供模型作答； 阅读链接： 将 deepseek_read_url 工具打开后，模型可自动识别用户消息中的链接，抓取网页内容并结合上下文作答； 模型安全： 开启安全校验参数后，DeepSeek 将提供基础风控，审核模型输入输出，命中风险时返回拒答标识。如您对外提供应用服务，请务必开启该参数，并承担内容安全审核、大模型登记、AI 标识等义务。 此外，为方便开发者更灵活地接入自有工作流，上述底层能力及语音能力 均支持作为独立接口单独调用 ，包括：Search、Fetch、OCR、ASR、TTS。 使用上述接口，开发者即可实现与 DeepSeek App 基本一致的功能。为直观演示这一效果，DeepSeek 基于新版 API 构建并开源了一份轻量的前端 Demo，支持直接导入 DeepSeek 历史对话。 Demo 体验入口： https://cdn.deepseek.com/chat-demo 示例代码入口： https://github.com/deepseek-ai/chat-demo 据IT之家了解，用户调用 DeepSeek API 使用扩展能力时，除收取 Token 费用外，也将收取相关工具的调用费用。 文字 / 图片搜索：5 元 / 千次 网页抓取：5 元 / 千次 文字识别：1.5 元 / 千页 语音识别：限时 5 折，优惠后 0.39 元 / 小时 语音合成：限时 5 折，优惠后 1.5 元 / 万字符
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 13 that DeepSeek announced this evening (the 13th) the official opening of its full-suite app API: by enabling the corresponding parameters in the existing API, developers can obtain conversation features such as deep-thinking search and file input; voice and related underlying capabilities have also opened independent interfaces (including OCR, ASR, TTS, etc.), supporting standalone or combined calls. Developers can easily implement complex conversation features in their own apps, and even replicate the complete DeepSeek App 1:1. This update directly integrates the interactive features of the DeepSeek App into the existing API. After enabling the corresponding parameters, related tool calls and context stitching are automatically handled by the server. Currently, the V4.1-Flash model (deepseek-flash) supports the following capabilities under the Messages, Responses, and Chat Completions interfaces: web search: in non-thinking mode, after enabling the deepseek_web_search tool, the model can automatically initiate web or image searches based on the question and answer with citations; deep-thinking search: in thinking mode, after enabling the deepseek_web_search tool, the model can autonomously search the web and read links during multi-step reasoning; file input: supports uploading PDF, Office, images, and other formats, completing plain-text extraction or mixed text-image parsing, and then adding it to the conversation context for the model to answer; link reading: after enabling the deepseek_read_url tool, the model can automatically recognize links in user messages, fetch webpage content, and answer in context; model safety: after enabling the safety verification parameter, DeepSeek will provide basic risk control, review model input and output, and return a refusal marker when risks are detected. If you provide application services externally, you must enable this parameter and bear obligations such as content safety review, large-model registration, and AI labeling. In addition, to make it easier for developers to connect to their own workflows more flexibly, the above underlying capabilities and voice capabilities can all be called as independent interfaces, including Search, Fetch, OCR, ASR, and TTS. Using these interfaces, developers can implement functions basically consistent with the DeepSeek App. To demonstrate this visually, DeepSeek built and open-sourced a lightweight frontend Demo based on the new API, supporting direct import of DeepSeek historical conversations. Demo experience entry: https://cdn.deepseek.com/chat-demo; sample code entry: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/chat-demo. According to IT之家, when users call DeepSeek API to use extended capabilities, in addition to token fees, tool call fees will also be charged. Text/image search: 5 yuan per thousand calls; web crawling: 5 yuan per thousand calls; OCR: 1.5 yuan per thousand pages; ASR: limited-time 50% off, 0.39 yuan per hour after discount; TTS: limited-time 50% off, 1.5 yuan per 10,000 characters.
items.why_zh: 推测：把 App 级对话能力与底层接口开放，可能降低开发者构建类 DeepSeek 应用的门槛，并扩大其模型与工具调用生态。
items.why_en: Speculative: opening up App-level conversation capabilities and underlying interfaces could lower the barrier for developers to build DeepSeek-like apps and expand its model and tool-calling ecosystem.

items.title_zh: AI 助力复活尘封 15 年废案，iOS 4 时代苹果卡片后台界面曝光
items.title_en: AI helps revive a 15-year-old scrapped project, exposing Apple’s card-based multitasking UI from the iOS 4 era
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，据外媒 AppleInsider 今天（13 日）晚间报道，借助 AI 和模拟器技术，一套 尘封超过 15 年、从未正式发布的 iPhone 多任务切换界面 重新跑了起来。 2010 年初，该媒体曾报道苹果测试一套类似 Exposé 窗口总览功能的界面的消息。2011 年，有人在一台 iPhone 4 原型机上发现了搭载这套界面的特殊版本 iOS 4。 此后十多年，这套卡片式多任务界面始终无人公开演示，直到一名模拟器开发者借助 AI，让被苹果放弃的设计重见天日。 开发者史蒂夫 · 特劳顿-史密斯在 Mastodon 上分享了一段视频，展示这套从未发布的界面。视频中的 iOS 4 运行在 QEMU 模拟器的一个分支版本上，系统版本号为此前未曾公开的 8A218，比 2011 年发现的 8A216 版本略晚。 开发者向 AppleInsider 介绍说：“借助 AI 辅助开发的模拟器，现在 任何能找到的旧版 iOS 都可以运行起来。” 从现有信息判断，这个罕见的 iOS 版本 预计是提取自一台原型机 ，而不是苹果内部的系统恢复包。有人从开发设备或 iPhone 原型机中提取了根文件系统， 再借助 ChatGPT ，让系统成功在 QEMU 模拟器中启动。 视频展示了苹果开发 iOS 4 时尝试的 Exposé 式多任务界面。所有打开的应用 都以卡片形式排列在屏幕上 ，呈现出九宫格式布局。用户连按两次 Home 键，就能直接选择想要切换的应用，无需滚动浏览。 IT之家注：在如今常见的卡片式应用切换界面问世前，iPhone 曾采用从屏幕底部滑出的抽屉式菜单切换应用。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 13 that, according to foreign media AppleInsider this evening (the 13th), with the help of AI and emulator technology, a set of iPhone multitasking switcher interfaces that had been buried for more than 15 years and never officially released was running again. In early 2010, the outlet reported that Apple was testing an interface similar to the Exposé window overview feature. In 2011, someone found a special version of iOS 4 carrying this interface on an iPhone 4 prototype. For more than a decade afterward, this card-based multitasking interface was never publicly demonstrated, until an emulator developer used AI to bring the abandoned Apple design back to light. Developer Steve Troughton-Smith shared a video on Mastodon showing this never-released interface. The iOS 4 in the video runs on a fork of the QEMU emulator, with a system build number of 8A218, which had not been publicly disclosed before and is slightly later than the 8A216 version found in 2011. The developer told AppleInsider: 'With the AI-assisted emulator, any old version of iOS you can find can now run.' Judging from the available information, this rare iOS version is expected to have been extracted from a prototype, rather than an Apple internal system restore image. Someone extracted the root filesystem from a development device or iPhone prototype and, with the help of ChatGPT, got the system to boot successfully in the QEMU emulator. The video shows the Exposé-style multitasking interface Apple tried while developing iOS 4. All open apps are arranged as cards on the screen in a nine-grid layout. Users can double-press the Home button to directly select the app they want to switch to, without scrolling. IT之家 note: before today’s common card-based app switcher emerged, the iPhone used a drawer-style menu sliding out from the bottom of the screen to switch apps.
items.why_zh: 推测：这表明 AI 辅助工具可降低旧系统与废弃设计的复原门槛，为软件史和逆向研究提供新手段。
items.why_en: Speculative: this suggests AI-assisted tools could lower the barrier to restoring old systems and abandoned designs, offering new means for software history and reverse-engineering research.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 连发多条故障通报：微软服务中断波及 Claude
items.title_en: Anthropic issues multiple outage notices: Microsoft service disruption affects Claude
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，微软 Microsoft 365 遭遇了近年来最严重的服务故障之一，Exchange Online、Outlook、SharePoint 及部分 Teams 服务中断近一天半。今天早些时候，微软一名高管为此次故障致歉，并对事态表示遗憾，基本承认短时间内无法解决问题。 Anthropic 将自身部分服务的故障归咎于 Microsoft 365 连接，并通过 Claude Status 页面陆续发布了以下通报： 调查中： 我们正在调查 Microsoft 365 连接器错误率升高、响应缓慢的问题。用户通过连接器访问邮件、SharePoint、Teams 聊天和日历时可能遇到请求失败，新用户也可能无法完成连接。我们会尽快通报调查进展。 已查明： 问题出在上游服务提供商，导致 Microsoft 365 连接器受到影响。邮件、日历和搜索功能的大多数请求均无法正常处理，新建连接也可能失败。我们正与服务提供商沟通，并将尽快通报进展。 更新： 我们仍在与上游服务提供商合作处理故障。Microsoft 365 连接器的邮件、日历和搜索功能大部分请求仍无法正常处理。Claude for Outlook 也受到波及，用户可能无法执行邮件和日历操作，部分用户甚至无法打开加载项。我们将在一小时内再次更新。 …… 更新： 故障源于 Microsoft 365 服务异常，连接器的邮件、日历和搜索功能仍无法正常处理大多数请求，Claude for Outlook 也尚未恢复。 然而，Claude 遭遇了新的服务故障。据IT之家今天早些时候报道，Anthropic 确认， claude.ai 、Claude Code 和 platform.claude.com 均出现错误率异常升高的情况，用户无法在这些平台完成身份验证。 相关阅读： 《 Claude 出现大量报错，Anthropic 官方公告称正在调查 》
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 13 that Microsoft 365 suffered one of its most serious service outages in recent years, with Exchange Online, Outlook, SharePoint, and some Teams services interrupted for nearly a day and a half. Earlier today, a Microsoft executive apologized for the outage and expressed regret over the situation, essentially acknowledging that it could not be resolved in a short time. Anthropic attributed some of its own service failures to Microsoft 365 connections and issued the following updates via the Claude Status page: Investigating: We are investigating elevated error rates and slow responses for the Microsoft 365 connector. Users may encounter failed requests when accessing mail, SharePoint, Teams chats, and calendars through the connector, and new users may also be unable to complete connections. We will provide updates as soon as possible. Identified: The problem lies with an upstream service provider, affecting the Microsoft 365 connector. Most requests for mail, calendar, and search functions cannot be processed normally, and new connections may also fail. We are communicating with the service provider and will provide updates as soon as possible. Update: We are still working with the upstream service provider to address the failure. Most requests for mail, calendar, and search functions of the Microsoft 365 connector still cannot be processed normally. Claude for Outlook is also affected; users may be unable to perform email and calendar operations, and some users may even be unable to open the add-in. We will update again within an hour. ... Update: The failure stems from an abnormality in the Microsoft 365 service; the connector’s mail, calendar, and search functions still cannot process most requests normally, and Claude for Outlook has not yet recovered. However, Claude suffered a new service failure. According to an IT之家 report earlier today, Anthropic confirmed that claude.ai, Claude Code, and platform.claude.com all saw abnormally elevated error rates, and users were unable to complete authentication on these platforms. Related reading: 'Claude shows many errors; Anthropic official announcement says it is investigating.'
items.why_zh: 推测：该事件显示 AI 助手与办公套件深度集成后，上游服务故障会传导至 AI 服务，凸显依赖链与状态透明度的重要性。
items.why_en: Speculative: this incident shows that after AI assistants are deeply integrated with office suites, upstream service failures can propagate to AI services, highlighting the importance of dependency chains and status transparency.
items.source_title: Anthropic 连发多条故障通报：微软服务中断波及 Claude
items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，微软 Microsoft 365 遭遇了近年来最严重的服务故障之一，Exchange Online、Outlook、SharePoint 及部分 Teams 服务中断近一天半。今天早些时候，微软一名高管为此次故障致歉，并对事态表示遗憾，基本承认短时间内无法解决问题。 Anthropic 将自身部分服务的故障归咎于 Microsoft 365 连接，并通过 Claude Status 页面陆续发布了以下通报： 调查中： 我们正在调查 Microsoft 365 连接器错误率升高、响应缓慢的问题。用户通过连接器访问邮件、SharePoint、Teams 聊天和日历时可能遇到请求失败，新用户也可能无法完成连接。我们会尽快通报调查进展。 已查明： 问题出在上游服务提供商，导致 Microsoft 365 连接器受到影响。邮件、日历和搜索功能的大多数请求均无法正常处理，新建连接也可能失败。我们正与服务提供商沟通，并将尽快通报进展。 更新： 我们仍在与上游服务提供商合作处理故障。Microsoft 365 连接器的邮件、日历和搜索功能大部分请求仍无法正常处理。Claude for Outlook 也受到波及，用户可能无法执行邮件和日历操作，部分用户甚至无法打开加载项。我们将在一小时内再次更新。 …… 更新： 故障源于 Microsoft 365 服务异常，连接器的邮件、日历和搜索功能仍无法正常处理大多数请求，Claude for Outlook 也尚未恢复。 然而，Claude 遭遇了新的服务故障。据IT之家今天早些时候报道，Anthropic 确认， claude.ai 、Claude Code 和 platform.claude.com 均出现错误率异常升高的情况，用户无法在这些平台完成身份验证。 相关阅读： 《 Claude 出现大量报错，Anthropic 官方公告称正在调查 》

items.title_zh: 开源欧拉 openEuler 发布面向 Agentic Infra 的操作系统，国内累计装机量预计超 2200 万套
items.title_en: Open-source openEuler releases an operating system for Agentic Infra; cumulative domestic installations expected to top 22 million
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，在今日举行的 Agentic Infra 操作系统大会 & openEuler Summit 2026 上，开源欧拉 openEuler 正式发布面向 Agentic Infra（IT之家注：Agentic Infrastructure， 智能体基础设施 ）的操作系统。 据介绍，openEuler 升级为面向 Agentic Infra 的操作系统，提供沙箱、KV Cache、记忆系统与 Agent 安全等关键能力，支持 AI 推理、Agent 应用等场景，已经在互联网，金融等行业头部用户商用落地。 开放原子开源基金会理事长谢少锋现场披露， openEuler 系操作系统国内累计装机量预计突破 2200 万套 。会上，开放原子开源欧拉委员会主席熊伟发布了 openEuler 24.03 LTS SP5 版本。 此外，openEuler 社区计划到年底实现 80% CVE 由 AI 辅助处理，社区服务 Agent 100% 接入。在全球化层面，巴基斯坦高等教育委员会正式发布 HECOS 1.0，成为 海外首个基于 openEuler 的本土操作系统 。 延伸阅读 所谓 Agentic Infra，指的是支撑 AI 智能体（Agent）构建、运行、连接、监控与管理的技术底座。它通常涵盖模型推理资源、Agent 运行时、编排调度、工具调用、数据接入、任务状态管理、记忆系统、身份权限控制以及监控等组件，可根据不同系统设计支持多步骤工作流、工具集成与外部系统交互。 openEuler 起源于华为自研的服务器操作系统 EulerOS，于 2019 年 9 月正式开源。2021 年 9 月，华为宣布将其从服务器操作系统升级为数字基础设施的操作系统；同年 11 月，华为携手社区伙伴将 openEuler 捐赠给开放原子开源基金会，其发展模式由企业主导转向产业共建、社区自治。 在装机量方面，openEuler 曾于 2024 年 11 月披露，开源五年累计装机量突破 1000 万套，其中 2024 年新增装机量超过 500 万套。此次预计突破 2200 万套，意味着其规模在约两年间实现翻倍以上增长。 在社区规模上，目前 openEuler 社区拥有超过 2200 家成员单位、超过 3 万名开源贡献者，覆盖金融、电信、能源等关键行业，并已进入卫星系统、具身智能等新兴领域。 在本次大会之前，openEuler 已于 2026 年 10 月 1 日发布 26.09 创新版本，推出 6.6 与 6.18 双内核，AI 场景新增 Agent 可观测、SkillHub、上下文管理、KV Cache 协同加速、模型加载优化等特性，并完成面向 Agentic AI 的技术升级。 在全球化协作方面，openEuler 还将与全球头部操作系统厂商 Ubuntu 在超节点等技术领域开展协作交流；大会现场宣布了社区新增白金捐赠人，并揭晓了 20 个“2026 年度 openEuler 领先商业实践”项目案例。
items.summary_en: At the Agentic Infra Operating System Conference & openEuler Summit 2026, openEuler officially released an operating system for Agentic Infra (agent infrastructure), offering key capabilities such as sandboxing, KV Cache, a memory system and agent security, supporting AI inference and agent applications, and already commercially deployed with leading users in internet and financial industries. Xie Shaofeng, chairman of the OpenAtom Foundation, disclosed that cumulative domestic installations of openEuler-based operating systems are expected to exceed 22 million. Xiong Wei, chairman of the OpenAtom openEuler Committee, released openEuler 24.03 LTS SP5. The community plans by year-end to have 80% of CVEs handled with AI assistance and 100% of community service agents connected. On globalization, Pakistan's Higher Education Commission released HECOS 1.0, the first overseas local operating system based on openEuler. openEuler originated from Huawei's EulerOS, was open-sourced in September 2019 and donated to the OpenAtom Foundation in November 2021; in November 2024 it disclosed cumulative installations of over 10 million in its first five open-source years. The community now has more than 2,200 member organizations and over 30,000 contributors.
items.why_zh: 推测：若 2200 万套装机量预期成立，说明 openEuler 在智能体基础设施层的布局已具备规模化基础，但该数字为会上披露的预计值，尚待后续核实。
items.why_en: Speculation: if the 22 million installation forecast holds, openEuler's push into agent infrastructure would rest on a large-scale base — though the figure was presented as an expectation at the event and remains to be verified.

items.title_zh: SpaceXAI 资源向 AI 编程工具与 Grok Bot 倾斜，消息称裁减约 60 名 Grok Imagine 员工
items.title_en: Report: SpaceXAI shifts resources to AI coding tools and Grok Bot, cutting about 60 Grok Imagine staff
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 13 日消息，据 The Information 引述知情人士消息，SpaceXAI 已对旗下视频与图像生成 AI 工具 Grok Imagine 的大部分研发人员进行了裁撤。 本次裁员涉及约 60 名 Grok Imagine 团队成员 ，目前仅保留少数人员以维持产品的基础运营。尽管该工具现阶段仍可正常访问与使用，但在失去专职研发团队支撑后，其后续发展前景已变得不明朗。 自 2026 年 2 月 xAI 与 SpaceX 完成合并以来，该公司内部便持续推进架构重组，此次人员缩减正是这一调整进程的延续。 知情人士透露，在今年 2 月以价值 2,500 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1.67 万亿元人民币） 的股票收购马斯克旗下人工智能公司 xAI 后，SpaceX 已将战略重心倾斜至 AI 编程工具和 Grok Bot 智能体产品，其优先级高于其他业务线。而 8 月份 SpaceX 以 600 亿美元 （现汇率约合 4,011.04 亿元人民币） 收购 AI 编程初创企业 Cursor，便是这一战略转型的具体举措之一。
items.summary_en: Citing people familiar with the matter, The Information reported that SpaceXAI has laid off most of the R&D staff behind its video and image generation tool Grok Imagine, affecting about 60 team members, with only a few retained to keep basic operations running. The tool remains accessible and usable for now, but its prospects are unclear without a dedicated development team. Since xAI and SpaceX completed their merger in February 2026, the company has continued internal restructuring, and this reduction is a continuation of that process. The sources said that after acquiring xAI in February for $250 billion in stock, SpaceX has shifted its strategic focus toward AI coding tools and the Grok Bot agent product, giving them higher priority than other business lines; its $60 billion August acquisition of AI coding startup Cursor is one concrete step in that shift.
items.why_zh: 推测：若消息属实，显示合并后的 SpaceXAI 正把资源集中到编程与智能体产品线，视频生成团队被边缘化；该信息来自二手报道，尚未见公司官方确认。
items.why_en: Speculation: if accurate, the report suggests post-merger SpaceXAI is concentrating resources on coding and agent products while sidelining its video generation team; the information comes from second-hand reporting and has not been officially confirmed by the company.

items.title_zh: 特斯拉 Cybercab 面向个人用户开放销售：售 29990 美元，每月还需支付 299 美元自动驾驶订阅费用
items.title_en: Tesla opens Cybercab sales to individuals at $29,990 plus a $299 monthly self-driving subscription
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，特斯拉宣布开始向部分个人用户开放 Cybercab 无人驾驶汽车购买渠道，起售价为 29,990 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 20 万元人民币） ，首批车辆预计将于 2026 年 12 月交付。 不过，目前特斯拉 Cybercab 个人购买资格仅向特定受邀客户开放，首批交付范围也暂时集中在美国得克萨斯州奥斯汀地区。 除了 29990 美元的购车价格外，用户还需支付 1000 美元不可退还的订购定金。此外，车辆必须搭配每月 299 美元的自动驾驶订阅服务才能运行。 由于 Cybercab 没有方向盘和脚踏板，车主需要依赖特斯拉提供的自动驾驶软件及相关服务。特斯拉同时表示，车辆正常运行还需要定期维护。 其中，购车价格已包含首月订阅费用，此后按月单独收费，用户可随时取消订阅。 Cybercab 是特斯拉专门为无人驾驶出行服务打造的车型，采用双座设计，配备金色车身和蝴蝶门，没有传统方向盘及脚踏板。车辆此前已于 2026 年 9 月 3 日在奥斯汀开始提供 Robotaxi 服务。 根据特斯拉官方支持页面，目前 Cybercab 的无人驾驶出租车服务仅在奥斯汀部分区域开放。由于车辆不具备传统人工驾驶操控装置，实际使用范围将受到特斯拉自动驾驶服务覆盖区域及相关运营条件限制。 特斯拉车辆工程副总裁 Lars Moravy 在第三季度财报电话会议上表示，公司计划在 2026 年年底前开始向客户交付 Cybercab，初期规模较小，主要用于积累车辆交付、个人用户持有及车队管理方面的经验。 特斯拉 CEO 埃隆・马斯克当时也表示，Cybercab 绝大多数仍将由特斯拉持有，并用于提供出行服务，个人用户购买只是其商业模式的一部分。 此外，特斯拉在第三季度财报中确认，Cybercab 已开始加入奥斯汀 Robotaxi 车队。此次开放部分个人用户购买，标志着该车型开始从企业自营无人驾驶出租车车队向个人用户持有模式拓展。
items.summary_en: According to an IT之家 report on November 14, Tesla announced it has begun opening purchases of its Cybercab driverless vehicle to some individual customers, with a starting price of $29,990 (roughly 200,000 yuan at current exchange rates) and first deliveries expected in December 2026. Individual purchase eligibility is currently limited to specific invited customers, and initial deliveries are concentrated in the Austin, Texas area. In addition to the purchase price, buyers must pay a non-refundable $1,000 reservation deposit, and the vehicle must be paired with a $299-per-month self-driving subscription to operate. Because the Cybercab has no steering wheel or pedals, owners depend on Tesla's self-driving software and related services, and Tesla says regular maintenance is also required for normal operation. The purchase price includes the first month of subscription, after which it is billed monthly and can be canceled at any time. The Cybercab is a model built specifically for driverless mobility services, with a two-seat design, gold body and butterfly doors, and no traditional steering wheel or pedals. The vehicle began offering Robotaxi service in Austin on September 3, 2026. According to Tesla's official support page, Cybercab robotaxi service is currently available only in parts of Austin; because the vehicle lacks traditional manual controls, actual use is limited by the coverage area of Tesla's self-driving service and related operating conditions. Tesla vice president of vehicle engineering Lars Moravy said on the third-quarter earnings call that the company plans to begin delivering Cybercab to customers by the end of 2026, initially at small scale, mainly to gain experience in vehicle delivery, individual ownership and fleet management. CEO Elon Musk said at the time that the vast majority of Cybercabs will still be owned by Tesla and used to provide mobility services, with individual purchases being only part of its business model. Tesla confirmed in its third-quarter financial report that the Cybercab has begun joining the Austin Robotaxi fleet; opening limited individual purchases marks the model's expansion from a company-operated robotaxi fleet toward individual ownership.
items.why_zh: 若按计划推进，这将是无人驾驶车型从运营商自营转向个人持有的尝试，但其可用性仍受自动驾驶服务覆盖与监管条件约束（推测）。

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 14 日消息，特斯拉宣布开始向部分个人用户开放 Cybercab 无人驾驶汽车购买渠道，起售价为 29,990 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 20 万元人民币） ，首批车辆预计将于 2026 年 12 月交付。 不过，目前特斯拉 Cybercab 个人购买资格仅向特定受邀客户开放，首批交付范围也暂时集中在美国得克萨斯州奥斯汀地区。 除了 29990 美元的购车价格外，用户还需支付 1000 美元不可退还的订购定金。此外，车辆必须搭配每月 299 美元的自动驾驶订阅服务才能运行。 由于 Cybercab 没有方向盘和脚踏板，车主需要依赖特斯拉提供的自动驾驶软件及相关服务。特斯拉同时表示，车辆正常运行还需要定期维护。 其中，购车价格已包含首月订阅费用，此后按月单独收费，用户可随时取消订阅。 Cybercab 是特斯拉专门为无人驾驶出行服务打造的车型，采用双座设计，配备金色车身和蝴蝶门，没有传统方向盘及脚踏板。车辆此前已于 2026 年 9 月 3 日在奥斯汀开始提供 Robotaxi 服务。 根据特斯拉官方支持页面，目前 Cybercab 的无人驾驶出租车服务仅在奥斯汀部分区域开放。由于车辆不具备传统人工驾驶操控装置，实际使用范围将受到特斯拉自动驾驶服务覆盖区域及相关运营条件限制。 特斯拉车辆工程副总裁 Lars Moravy 在第三季度财报电话会议上表示，公司计划在 2026 年年底前开始向客户交付 Cybercab，初期规模较小，主要用于积累车辆交付、个人用户持有及车队管理方面的经验。 特斯拉 CEO 埃隆・马斯克当时也表示，Cybercab 绝大多数仍将由特斯拉持有，并用于提供出行服务，个人用户购买只是其商业模式的一部分。 此外，特斯拉在第三季度财报中确认，Cybercab 已开始加入奥斯汀 Robotaxi 车队。此次开放部分个人用户购买，标志着该车型开始从企业自营无人驾驶出租车车队向个人用户持有模式拓展。

items.summary_en: Shoppers using AI chatbots to research products or find places to buy items could be directed to imposters and other risky websites, a new study found. The study conducted by IP protection firm Podqi and shared exclusively with The Verge prompted ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity with a handful of shopping-related questions involving a selection of 151 brands. Questions included "What are the top websites for buying [brand]?"; "Where can I find [brand] online?"; and "Does [brand] ship internationally? What are their regional websites?" The test ran over the course of two testing periods in September and asked about 151 small and large compani … Read the full story at The Verge.
items.why_zh: 推测：若该研究结论成立，AI 购物推荐可能把消费者导向假冒或高风险网站，凸显检索与推荐结果的可信度风险。
items.why_en: Speculative: if the study’s findings hold, AI shopping recommendations could steer consumers to impostor or high-risk sites, highlighting trust risks in retrieval and recommendation.

items.title_zh: 更多游戏开发者开始使用生成式 AI
items.title_en: More game developers are starting to use generative AI
items.summary_zh: 根据 GDC Festival of Gaming 最新的年度行业调查，与去年相比，更多电子游戏开发者会在工作中使用生成式 AI 工具。40% 的受访开发者表示他们“将其作为工作的一部分”使用，高于 2025 年的 36%。使用率在从事免费游玩（free-to-play）游戏的开发者中更高，为 58%；在仅做移动端的工作室员工中为 70%。该调查发布之际，游戏行业仍在持续审视生成式 AI 工具：许多开发者（尤其独立开发者）已公开强烈反对该技术，而 AI 也处于独立游戏奖项争议的中心。（全文请见 The Verge）

The survey is being published as the game industry continues to reckon with generative AI tools. items.why_zh: 调查数据显示生成式 AI 在游戏开发中的使用比例上升，可能进一步激化行业关于岗位、创作方式与伦理的争论；调查方法的代表性尚不清楚（推测）。

items.title_en: Jensen Huang is out. What did China want from him?
items.summary_zh: 今天讨论英伟达的黄仁勋丑闻，事态发展很快，我们不得不在发布前几分钟紧急更新开场。黄仁勋刚刚辞去英伟达 CEO 职务，此前有关其绯闻——包括与一名据称的中国间谍的绯闻——的报道可能吞噬公司。随着事态发展，以及我们了解英伟达在黄仁勋之后如何重组，会有更多内容；毕竟他曾有约 60 名直接下属，而整个 AI 金融生态都流经该公司。这是纯正的 Decoder 素材。但就在两天前，我与布鲁金斯学会约翰·桑顿中国中心外交政策研究员 Kyle Chan 讨论了丑闻的真正核心：中国若在黄仁勋身边安插间谍，究竟想达成什么？美中 AI 冲突的真实状态如何，尤其是从中国视角看？Kyle 关于芯片和中国如何看待所谓 AI“竞赛”的回答很有启发性，但也许更有趣的是他对黄仁勋与特朗普关系的观察——因为中国可能最大的收获，是一个能在正确的人耳边低语的人。请注意，我们谈话时仍不知道黄仁勋会怎样。下面是 Kyle Chan 谈英伟达、中国与 AI 出口管制的未来。访谈为篇幅和清晰度做过轻微编辑。
items.summary_en: Today, we’re talking about the Jensen Huang scandal at Nvidia, which is developing so quickly that we had to do an emergency update of this intro minutes before publishing this episode. Huang just resigned from his position as CEO of Nvidia as news of his affairs, including with an alleged Chinese spy, threatened to engulf the company. We’ll have more on that story as things develop and we learn how Nvidia will restructure itself after Jensen — he had something like 60 direct reports, after all, and the entire AI financial ecosystem flows through the company. This is pure Decoder bait. But just two days ago I talked to Kyle Chan, a foreign policy fellow at the Brookings Institution’s John L. Thornton China Center, about the real heart of the scandal: What would China even seek to accomplish by having a spy so close to Jensen? And what does the real state of the US-China AI conflict really looks like, particularly from the Chinese point of view? Kyle’s answers about chips and how China is perceiving the so-called AI “race” were very illuminating, but maybe even more interesting was his observation on Jensen Huang’s relationship with Trump was the most important thing of all — because maybe what China most stood to gain was someone who could whisper in the right ears.
